result.rationale: In googlecalendar CalendarService, refreshOAuthTokens can return a raw fetch Response (the CALCOM_CREDENTIAL_SYNC_ENDPOINT branch) instead of gaxios's `{ res }` object. The code then does `const token = res?.data;` and accesses `token.access_token`, which throws TypeError on undefined data; the surrounding try/catch in refreshAccessToken swallows it and returns the old (expired) auth as if refresh succeeded. The diff shows both the sync branch returning `response` from fetch (no `.data`) and the consuming code unchanged to use `.data`, so the mechanism is verifiable.
